posts.text: Very fun to mess with AI models by telling them you disproved the Jacobian Conjecture in your sleep.

Another exciting week for The AGI Chronicles!

Publishers Weekly and Kirkus, the two main publishing trades, both gave it starred reviews. 

And Ray Kurzweil, the legendary futurist whose books inspired Sam, Dario, Shane Legg, and others to work on AI, gave it a very kind blurb.

Starting to think we may have cooked with this one!

An endorsement from @WalterIsaacson, the GOAT of narrative nonfiction, would be a dream for any writer. 

It's especially thrilling for me with this book, because so much of The AGI Chronicles was patterned on his great books on Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, Jennifer Doudna and other historic figures. 

Thank you, Walter!
